image_description: A landscape photograph featuring three bison in a dry, grassy field. One bison is prominent in the foreground left, facing forward with visible horns and head. Another bison is in the foreground right, grazing with its head down, showing its hump and hindquarters. A third bison is visible in the mid-ground left, walking laterally. The background consists of rolling hills and sparse vegetation under a bright sky.

The eye of the foreground left bison is visible and appears dark, consistent with the checkpoint.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blended into the thick fur of the head, which is typical for bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: All visible bison exhibit the characteristic massive build and high shoulder hump associated with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.

Comparing the foreground right bison's rear to its front, the fur on the hindquarters appears smoother and less voluminous than the forequarters.

The legs are mostly obscured by tall grass. While the upper legs look sturdy, the hooves are completely hidden from view, making this checkpoint untestable.

The legs of the bison in the middle distance appear somewhat indistinct and merge slightly with the ground plane. While partially due to distance/resolution, the structural definition of the lower legs is weaker than expected for a rigid object, hinting at slight geometric instability.
